higherTimeframeTrend.definitionLong: On the previous completed higher-timeframe bar: EMA20 > EMA50, close > EMA20, and EMA50 > EMA50 five higher-timeframe bars earlier.
higherTimeframeTrend.definitionShort: Mirror: EMA20 < EMA50, close < EMA20, and EMA50 < EMA50 five higher-timeframe bars earlier.
higherTimeframeTrend.ema200NotRequired: The higher-timeframe filter is directional confirmation, not a second copy of the local trend stack. Local A1 trend still requires EMA20/EMA50/EMA200 exactly as locked.
higherTimeframeTrend.causality: The current/incomplete higher-timeframe bucket is never used.

referenceBaselineDeduplication.key: instrument + evaluated timeframe + signal timestamp + direction
referenceBaselineDeduplication.purpose: Create one frozen E1 reference action per opportunity clock for precision/recall and utility-delta comparison.
referenceBaselineDeduplication.baselineExecution: trigger_close entry with E1 frozen structure_plus_atr_noise stop, hybrid_structure_volatility_ladder targets and fixed_full_exit management.

referenceOpportunityAudit.matchingRule: An A1 trade captures a good reference opportunity only when it is on the exact same instrument/timeframe/signal timestamp/direction key.

candidateLong: prior completed 50-bar high above actual entry
prior completed 120-bar high above actual entry
targetConstruction.selection: Sort causal candidates from nearest to farthest in trade direction. TP1 is the nearest progressive candidate at or beyond 0.80R; TP2 the next distinct progressive candidate at or beyond 1.50R; TP3 the next distinct progressive candidate at or beyond 2.50R.
targetConstruction.failure: If all three cannot be selected from the candidate set, do not trade.

entryAndCost.cost: round-trip modeled from the locked one-way bps using entry and exit notional divided by initial price risk
entryAndCost.gapRule: If next-open entry is already through the structural stop or risk/ATR leaves [0.50,2.50], do not trade.

timeAndBreadthMetrics.firstSecondHalf: chronological midpoint of entered A1 trades by signal timestamp
timeAndBreadthMetrics.positiveBlock: mean net R > 0 within instrument/timeframe block
timeAndBreadthMetrics.singleMarketFamilyPositiveContribution: maximum positive family total R divided by sum of positive family total R; zero if no positive family totals

bootstrapDelta.a1Utility: A1 net R on matching entered trade, otherwise 0
bootstrapDelta.baselineUtility: frozen E1 trigger_close net R on the same deduplicated reference candidate, otherwise 0
bootstrapDelta.method: hierarchical instrument/timeframe resampling with circular candidate blocks, exactly the locked seed/iterations/block length

forbiddenAfterFreeze: Changing HTF trend definition after A1 results.
Changing target candidate set or reward floors after A1 results.
Changing baseline dedup priority after A1 results.
Dropping fresh instruments because their A1 performance is weak.
Changing gate thresholds after A1 results.
